about: A machine saved by the game as it was the day before jewels (the catcher on the pusher’s front at 8d2d1e61, storage version 3): written by that version’s own serialize, after a minute and a half of play on both rails, caught with a medal on a rail and one in the air, a prize ball on the field, a spin on the screen and more held. `then` is what that version’s machine did in the next four seconds, with a generator started from `seed` and nobody feeding it. No treasure line ends in those four seconds, so a machine with jewels does the same.
